When she has fun, this energetic and generally clumsy girl shows an uncanny ability to immerse herself in what she likes. Always giving her all to the task at hand, the last thing Nazuha would want is to stay still and wait.

With a surprising appetite for such a little girl, Nazuha is often munching on snacks and takes seconds with every meal.
